fields.help_en:
The tag key of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. If you specify this parameter, it cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

您最多可输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. If you specify this parameter, it cannot be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values

BandwidthBillingType.description_en:
The bandwidth billing method. Valid values:
BandwidthPackage: billed by bandwidth plan.
CDT: billed by traffic and settled uniformly by Cloud Data Transfer (CDT).
CDT95: billed by the 95th percentile bandwidth and settled uniformly by CDT. This billing method is available only for whitelisted users
BandwidthBillingType.description_zh:
带宽计费方式。
BandwidthPackage：按带宽包计费。
CDT：按流量计费并由云数据传输（Cloud DataTransfer，简称CDT）统一结算。
CDT95：按95计费并由CDT统一结算。该带宽计费方式仅白名单用户可用

CrossBorderStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the cross-border line feature is enabled for the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

true: The cross-border line feature is enabled, and cross-border lines can be accelerated.

false: The cross-border line feature is disabled, and cross-border lines cannot be accelerated
